result.title: Decentralized Multi-View, Multi-Zone Tracking for Scalable Camera Networks
result.summary: We present a decentralized multi-view tracking system for scalable camera networks. Single-view detections are projected to bird's-eye-view (BEV) coordinates and fused by independent multi-view trackers, each managing a dynamic spatial zone. To support scalability across spatially partitioned camera networks, we introduce a decentralized layer for trajectory unification, utilizing a locking protocol and periodic track-merging operations termed global collate. This process is supported by a delayed-output buffering mechanism that retroactively applies history corrections. The configurable delay window absorbs asynchronous coordination latency and helps stabilize cross-zone identity consistency. We detail the design of dynamic zone polygons, consensus-based coordination, and the validation framework, which together maintain global ID consistency with minimal accuracy loss compared to a single-instance baseline in the evaluated configurations.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一种去中心化的多视角、多区域跟踪系统：将单视角检测投影到 BEV 坐标后由各自管理动态空间区域的跟踪器融合，并用锁定协议、周期性「global collate」轨迹合并和延迟输出缓冲回溯修正历史，以在保持全局 ID 一致性的同时扩展相机网络规模。
AI.relevance_reason: 属多相机跟踪系统工程，但其跨源证据融合、延迟窗口吸收异步延迟与回溯式状态修正，可能与 LVR 中多源视觉证据整合和推理状态回溯校正的问题构成概念类比，可供核查；与本主线的推理机制联系较远。
